title: cliplib.json
description: The clips available for one skeleton (spec 107). Retargeted onto the rig family once and shared by every unit in it -- retargeting the same clip per unit is a bug, not a variation.

$comment.description: A note for whoever opens the file next. JSON has no comments and additionalProperties is false.

skeletonRef.description: Path to the skeleton.json these clips are bound to by bone name.

source.description: The animation-only .glb -- mesh data is stripped at bake time, so one clip set serves N units.

durationMs.description: Authored length in milliseconds. Milliseconds rather than glTF's seconds so no reader has to remember which unit a time field is in. NOT authoritative over gameplay: an actionTiming rescales this.

events.description: Markers in NORMALIZED time, ascending. Normalized is the whole point: time-scaling a clip to fit a wind-up must not move where the hit lands.
